note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs records with B/L numbers, destination and HS codes — not merely website claims. Only 29339990 matches the declared set (as 293399); 281122 and 293329 are not evidenced in any shipment row. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in base, actual codes recorded, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
